user.title: Whose CRM?
user.description: Each Home Assistant user has their own Hearth CRM, stored separately. Choose the user who owns this one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Google Contacts
reauth_confirm.description: Google no longer accepts this CRM's access. Sign in to Google again to keep syncing contacts.

abort.already_configured: That user already has a Hearth CRM.
abort.no_users: There are no active Home Assistant users to create a CRM for.
abort.invalid_user: That Home Assistant user does not exist or cannot have a CRM.
abort.missing_configuration: Add a Google OAuth client in Application Credentials before connecting Google Contacts.
abort.google_needs_a_crm: Google Contacts is connected from an existing Hearth CRM: open its menu and choose Reconfigure.
abort.wrong_account: This Hearth is linked to a different Google account. Sign in with the same account.
abort.account_in_use: That Google account is already linked to another Hearth CRM. Each CRM needs its own Google account.
abort.people_api_unavailable: Could not read your Google account. Check that the Google People API is enabled for your Google Cloud project.

application_credentials.description: Hearth syncs people to the owner's Google Contacts with a Google Cloud OAuth client you create. Set up the [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}), then create a Web application client on the [Credentials page]({oauth_creds_url}). See [Hearth's Google Contacts guide]({more_info_url}) for the full steps.

import.name: Import bundle
import.description: Replace all of a CRM's data with a bundle and write a review report. Refused after cutover, and refused over changes made since the last import unless replace_existing is set.

config_entry_id.name: CRM
config_entry_id.description: The Hearth CRM to act on.

path.name: Path
path.description: The bundle's file name (or a path) inside this CRM's imports folder, /config/hearth_crm/<user id>/imports/. Anything that resolves outside that folder is refused.

replace_existing.name: Replace existing changes
replace_existing.description: Discard changes made in Hearth since the last import. Never overrides cutover.

export.name: Export bundle
export.description: Write the CRM and its photos to a bundle in the CRM's exports folder.

config_entry_id.name: CRM
config_entry_id.description: The Hearth CRM to act on.

confirm_cutover.name: Confirm cutover
confirm_cutover.description: Mark Hearth as the source of truth. From then on bundle imports are refused. This cannot be undone.

config_entry_id.name: CRM
config_entry_id.description: The Hearth CRM to act on.

google_sync.name: Sync Google Contacts
google_sync.description: Sync a CRM's people to its owner's Google Contacts now, or with dry run only report what would change. A real run needs Google connected, the sync switched on and cutover confirmed. Hearth never deletes a Google contact.

config_entry_id.name: CRM
config_entry_id.description: The Hearth CRM to act on.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only report who would be created, updated or skipped. Nothing is sent to Google and nothing is written.
